items.stem: A claim is denied for medical necessity. Select TWO coder actions that correctly address it.

options.text: Verify the diagnosis code supports the service per payer policy
options.rationale: Correct: linking a supporting diagnosis is central to medical necessity.

options.text: Check the record for documentation that justifies the service
options.rationale: Correct: documentation must support the billed service.

options.text: Change the diagnosis to one that pays regardless of the record
options.rationale: Altering codes to secure payment is fraud.
Resubmitting without change will deny again.

options.text: Add random modifiers until it pays

items.explanation: Verifying diagnosis support and checking documentation address a medical-necessity denial.
